description: Use this when a user asks what is stored, agrees to have their progress tracked, or asks to stop tracking. Stores the user's consent decision for derived performance scores and, separately, for a coaching-contact record. Only ever called in response to an explicit user decision — never proactively, and never as a default prompt at the end of a conversation.

allowCoachingContact.description: True to allow a coaching lead to be stored and contacted.

optOut.description: True to delete all stored data for this user and stop tracking.

storeProgressScores.description: True to store derived pillar scores so progress can be tracked over time.

name: fitness.set_privacy_consent
title: Set Privacy Consent
